<thought>Based on the mass spectrum, the molecular ion is at m/z ≈ 199.0 with a characteristic Br isotopic pattern (M and M+2 of similar intensity). The monoisotopic mass matches the formula C₈H₁₀BrN. A structure that fits this formula is para‑bromo‑phenethylamine, whose SMILES is “c1ccc(Br)cc1CCN”. This SMILES is valid and corresponds to the derived formula.</thought>
<final_answer>c1ccc(Br)cc1CCN</final_answer>
